title: QA challenge: Northgate Console
badge: Fake B2B admin · not a live bank
intro: A small banking back-office: login, corporate accounts (full CRUD), transfers, Access & Identity, and audit. Same area I tested at work — users, roles, account structures — not payment-provider rails. I planted bugs in the UI and in the REST API. Compare the table with Chrome Network / the API log and with the Console docs spec. Locators have data-testid for Playwright UI + API checks.
hint: Docs is the spec: auth, accounts CRUD, transfers, Access, REST, seed data, locators. Product UI is English on purpose.
testsIntro: Playwright + TypeScript against this Console. Repo is public. Last CI report is below (HTML + Allure).
testsRunHint: Starts the selected suite on GitHub Actions. The report below refreshes when the run finishes. One run every few minutes.
testsRunHintReport: The last CI report is below. Run tests reloads it.

bugs.title: Wrong password uses the wrong HTTP meaning
bugs.hint: Fail login. Read the status. Is this 401 or 403?

bugs.title: Logout does not end the session
bugs.hint: Log out. Reload. Are you still in?

bugs.title: Account search is case-sensitive
bugs.hint: Search a holder in lowercase. Names are Title Case.

bugs.title: Active filter still shows Frozen
bugs.hint: Filter status = Active. Is a Frozen account still in the list?

bugs.title: Currency filter does not filter
bugs.hint: Set currency to EUR. Check if USD / GBP rows remain. Compare with the API query.

bugs.title: Max balance is exclusive
bugs.hint: Set max balance to an amount that exists on a row (150). That row should stay.

bugs.title: Client sort does not sort by client
bugs.hint: Click the Client column. Watch the order vs IBAN.

bugs.title: Open-accounts KPI does not match Active rows
bugs.hint: Compare Open accounts with how many Active rows are in the table.

bugs.title: Freeze does not persist
bugs.hint: Freeze a row. Read the PATCH vs the next GET. Reload.

bugs.title: UI balance does not match the API
bugs.hint: Open Ada Chen. Compare the table amount with GET /accounts.

bugs.title: Insufficient funds returns 200
bugs.hint: Send more than the source balance. Check HTTP status. Should this be 4xx?

bugs.title: Admin invite does not stay Admin
bugs.hint: On Access, invite someone as Admin. Check the role in the table.
